risk_note: RV2 read-only port (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator ruling D10-456 ④): payout's quarterly tax-detail reader for the admin export worker (08 BR-WDR-21). It lists PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL withdrawals whose paid_at falls in the natural +08:00 quarter (@couli/domain chinaMonthRange), ordered paid_at, id with a base64url position cursor, limit 1..1000 (default 500); fields are the application amount_fen, tax_fen, paid_at, out_biz_no, payout_channel, income_type and the payee account masked by domain/mask-payee.ts after the caller's decrypt. No money is moved or written: plain SELECTs on the caller's handle, no locks, no logging; names, id numbers, the account in clear and the HMAC never leave the port (the admin worker adds names and id numbers through identity's port; the export entry, permissions, step-up, OSS and audit are the admin lane's). Refusals (bad quarter / cursor / limit) are decided before the database is touched. No frozen test changed; no contract change; no migration. Test-machine full verify with PROP_RUNS=2000（D10-496）.
